input.quote: For a renewable one-year term commencing upon the Maintenance Commencement Date, subject to payment of maintenance fees in accordance with the Fee Schedule but without additional fees or charges, Garman shall provide the following Maintenance Services:
input.rationale: The only renewal-related language in the Agreement is the description of the maintenance term as a "renewable one-year term" (p0065); the licence itself is perpetual (p0117) and fees are simply left to the Fee Schedule (p0084). Nothing anywhere states how the maintenance term renews, gives Sparkling a defined non-renewal notice window, or limits renewal-term fee increases, so no usable renewal clause exists and neither fallback parameter (notice window, uplift cap) is established. We therefore insert the shortest renewal mechanic at the preferred level: automatic twelve-month renewals, a thirty (30) day Sparkling opt-out, a sixty (60) day Garman reminder and increases capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%. No walk-away feature (multi-year auto-renewal or >90 day window) is present today; the gap is the absence of terms, not an adverse one.

mappings.element: Renewal requires mutual written agreement unless every conditional automatic-renewal element below is met.
If renewal is automatic, each renewal term is no longer than 12 months.
If renewal is automatic, Customer may opt out on no more than 30 days' notice.
If renewal is automatic, Vendor must remind Customer at least 60 days before renewal.
If renewal permits price increases, each increase is capped at the lesser of CPI and 3 percent.

proposal.summary: Add renewal mechanic for the maintenance term: automatic 12-month renewals, 30-day Sparkling opt-out, 60-day Garman reminder, uplift capped at lesser of CPI and 3%.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The maintenance term is described only as "renewable", with no renewal mechanic, exit window or price protection, so we added automatic twelve-month renewals that Sparkling may exit on thirty (30) days' notice, a sixty (60) day renewal reminder from Garman and a cap on maintenance fee increases at the lesser of CPI and 3%. We can accept a fallback of a sixty (60) day non-renewal window with increases capped at 5%.

ops.text: The maintenance term shall renew automatically for successive renewal terms of twelve (12) months each, unless Sparkling gives Garman written notice of non-renewal at least thirty (30) days before the end of the then-current term. Garman shall remind Sparkling of the upcoming renewal at least sixty (60) days before the end of the then-current term. Maintenance fees for any renewal term shall not increase by more than the lesser of the increase in the Consumer Price Index during the then-current term and three percent (3%).
